fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Nakamura and I live at 296 Elmstead Street, Salem, MA 01945. You can reach me on (555) 366-8323 or dmitri.nakamura@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 5 August 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00128. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Nakamura on (555) 366-8323 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 5 August 2025.
Site visit to 296 Elmstead Street. Neighbour Naomi Abernathy was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
